story:
Why this one matters: a championship leader starting on pole at Silverstone is supposed to bank 25 points. Antonelli banked none that counted. Leclerc won in 1:27:11.335. George Russell was 0.427 behind. Lewis Hamilton 0.772 behind. A Ferrari 1-3 with a Mercedes in the sandwich.

Antonelli's Sky Sports driver page lists Great Britain: grid 1st, finish 15th. The lead he had been building since China suddenly had a dent. Russell closed. Hamilton, already a winner in Barcelona, stood on another podium in red.

Five days later Belgium would restore the kid. This Sunday belongs to Leclerc.
stakes: A home-soil weekend for Russell, a first 2026 win for Leclerc, a dent in Antonelli's march.
rivalryAngle: Mercedes pole to 15th. Ferrari first and third.
